Read in data

```{r}
diet = read.table("diet.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",")
```

Problem 1a

```{r}
exercise = ifelse(diet$method == "exercise", 1, 0)
both = ifelse(diet$method == "both", 1,0)
model = lm(weight_lost ~ calories, data = diet)
summary(model)
```

Problem 1c

```{r}
exercise = ifelse(diet$method == "exercise", 1, 0)
both = ifelse(diet$method == "both", 1,0)
model1 = lm(weight_lost ~ calories + exercise + both, data = diet)
summary(model1)
model2 = lm(weight_lost ~ calories + age, data = diet)
summary(model2)
model3 = lm(weight_lost ~ calories + exercise + both + age, data = diet)
summary(model3)

```
